sn22.84:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Tisso Bhagavato pitucchāputto sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evam āroceti || ||
sn22.84:1.3: Api me āvuso madhurakajāto viya kāyo || disā pi me na pakkhāyanti || dhammā pi maṃ na paṭibhanti || thīnamiddhaṃ ca me cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati || anabhirato ca brahmacariyaṃ carāmi hoti ca me dhammesu vicikicchā ti || || 3
sn22.84:2.1: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || 4 Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn22.84:2.2: Āyasmā bhante Tisso Bhagavato pitucchāputto sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evam āroceti || ||
sn22.84:2.3: Api me āvuso madhurakajāto viya kāyo || disā pi me na pakkhāyanti || dhammā pi maṃ na paṭibhanti || thīnamiddhaṃ ca me cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati || anabhirato ca brahmacariyaṃ carāmi || hoti ca me dhammesu vicikicchā ti || || 5
sn22.84:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā aññataram bhikkhum āmantesi || ||
sn22.84:3.2: Ehi tvam bhikkhu mama vacanena Tissaṃ bhikkhum āmantehi || Satthā taṃ āvuso Tissa āmantetīti || || 6
sn22.84:3.3: Evam bhante ti kho so bhikkhu Bhagavato paṭissutvā yenāyasmā Tisso tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantam Tissam etad avoca || ||
sn22.84:3.5: Evam āvuso ti kho āyasmā Tisso tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 8 Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Tissam Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn22.84:3.6: Saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Tissaṃ sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnam evam ārocesi || ||
sn22.84:3.7: Api me āvuso madhurakajāto viya kāyo || la || hoti ca me dhammesu vicikicchā ti || ||
sn22.84:3.10: rūpe avigatarāgassa avigatachandassa avigarapemassa avigatapipāsassa avigatapariḷāhassa avigatataṇhassa tassa rūpassa vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā uppajjanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā ti || ||
sn22.84:4.7: tesaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā uppajjanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā ti || ||
sn22.84:5.3: yathā taṃ [saṅkhāresu avigatarāgassa ||] viññāṇe avigatarāgassa avigatachandassa avigatapemassa avigatapipāsassa avigatapariḷāhassa avigatataṇhassa tassa viññāṇassa vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā uppajjanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā ti || ||
sn22.84:6.5: rūpe vigatarāgassa vigatachandassa vigatapemassa vigatapipāsassa vigatapariḷāhassa vigatataṇhassa tassa rūpassa vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā uppajjanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā ti || ||
sn22.84:7.7: viññāṇe vigatarāgassa vigatachandassa vigatapemassa vigatapipāsassa vigatapariḷāhassa vigatataṇhassa tassa viññāṇassa vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā uppajjanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā ti || ||
sn22.84:8.5: rūpaṃ ṇiccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.84:8.10: Viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.84:9.2: eko puriso amaggakusalo eko puriso maggakusalo || ||
sn22.84:9.3: Tam enaṃ so amaggakusalo puriso amum maggakusalam purisam maggam puccheyya ||
sn22.84:9.7: tena muhuttam gantvā dakkhissasi dvidhāpathaṃ || tattha vāmaṃ muñcitvā dakkhiṇaṃ gaṇhāhi ||
sn22.84:9.9: tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi tibbam vanasaṇḍaṃ || ||
sn22.84:9.11: tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi mahantam ninnaṃ pallalaṃ || ||
sn22.84:9.13: tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi sobbham papātaṃ || ||
sn22.84:9.15: tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi samam bhūmibhāgaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ || || 27
sn22.84:10.1: Upamā kho myāyaṃ Tissa katā atthassa viññāpanāya
sn22.84:10.3: Puriso amaggakusalo ti kho Tissa puthujjanassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ || ||
sn22.84:10.4: Puriso maggakusalo ti kho Tissā Tathāgatassetam adhivacanam arahato sammāsambuddhassa || || 29
sn22.84:10.5: Dvidhāpatho ti kho Tissa vicikicchāyetam adhivacanaṃ || ||
sn22.84:10.6: Vāmamaggo ti kho Tissa aṭṭhaṅgikassetam micchāmaggassa adhivacanaṃ || seyyathīdam
sn22.84:10.8: Dakkhiṇamaggo ti kho Tissa ariyassetam aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa adhivacanaṃ || seyyathīdaṃ
sn22.84:10.10: Tibbo vanasaṇḍo ti kho Tissa avijjāyetaṃ adhivacanaṃ || ||
sn22.84:10.11: Mahantaṃ ninnaṃ pallalanti kho Tissa kāmānaṃ etam adhivacanaṃ || ||
sn22.84:10.12: Sobbho papāto ti kho Tissa kodhūpāyāsassetam adhivacanaṃ || ||
sn22.84:10.13: Samo bhūmibhāgo ramaṇīyo ti kho Tissa nibbānassetam adhivacanaṃ || || 31
sn22.84:10.15: aham ovādena aham anuggahena aham anusāsaniyāti || || 32
